verdict.rationale: Sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times into an email is a fair question for an email-and-calendar client like Outlook, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents such a feature. The nearest item, getting or updating a user's working hours via the Graph API, is an adjacent setting rather than inserting availability into a message, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
